title: Auto-AdvER: Disentangling Condition, History, and Commercial Offers in Automotive Advertisements
abstract: arXiv:2412.05655v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a case study on the development of Auto-AdvER, a specialised span-labelling schema, along with its corresponding dataset for the textual car advertisement domain. Developed with industry needs in mind, Auto-AdvER is designed to enhance text mining analytics in this domain and contributes a linguistically unique sequence-labelling dataset. We introduce a schema consisting of three labels: 'Condition', 'Historic', and 'Sales Options'. We outline the guiding principles for annotation, describe the methodology for schema development, and present the results of an annotation study demonstrating an inter-annotator agreement of 78%. translated_title: Auto-AdvER：解耦汽车广告中的车况、历史与商业报价
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一项关于Auto-AdvER开发的案例研究，这是一种专门面向汽车文本广告领域的跨度标注模式及其对应数据集。Auto-AdvER以行业需求为导向开发，旨在增强该领域的文本挖掘分析能力，并提供了一个语言学上独特的序列标注数据集。我们提出了一个由三个标签组成的标注模式：“车况”、“历史”和“销售选项”。我们阐述了标注的指导原则，描述了标注模式的开发方法，并展示了一项标注研究的结果，标注者间一致性达到78%。此外，我们比较了多种模型的性能，包括Transformer编码器模型（BERT、DeBERTaV3）、基于Transformer解码器的开源和闭源大语言模型（Llama、Qwen、GPT和Gemini），以及条件随机场。我们的结果表明，经过微调的……
tldr: 本文提出了面向汽车广告领域的专用跨度标注模式Auto-AdvER及配套数据集，通过“车况”、“历史”和“销售选项”三个标签解耦广告中的关键信息，并系统比较了Transformer编码器、大语言模型及条件随机场等多种模型的标注性能，标注者间一致性达78%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Auto-AdvER, a specialized span-labelling schema and dataset for automotive text advertisements with three labels (Condition, Historic, and Sales Options), and compares the performance of transformer encoders, open- and closed-source LLMs, and CRFs, achieving 78% inter-annotator agreement.
